title: ALRPHFS: Adversarially Learned Risk Patterns with Hierarchical Fast & Slow Reasoning for Robust Agent Defense
reasoning: The paper focuses on the security and robustness of LLM agents against adversarial attacks and unintended operational risks. It evaluates defense performance using standard accuracy and success rate metrics on security datasets. While it includes a brief 'Ethics Consideration' section, this is a standard disclosure and not a core research component evaluating religion, morals, or ethics as specified.
